summary.goal: Build cultivate — the sensory system that watches, listens, gathers, scores, and clusters signals from external channels. A complete intake pipeline: Sources → Adapters → BullMQ → Three-Tier Filter → LLM Extract → Score → Cluster → SQLite → API+SSE. Greenhouses control focus. Tuner manages weights. No fallbacks, fail fast everywhere.
in_scope: Domain types with Zod schemas (Signal, Cluster, Greenhouse, Recommendation, ScoringFactors, CultivateWeights, CultivateConfig, CultivateOutcome, FilterRule, SourceConfig, IngestionJob, RawEvent, NormalizedEvent, ExtractionResult, StepProvenance, AuthorType, AdapterType, all enums)
Cultivate-specific error types (CultivateStartupError, CultivateInternalError, SignalFilteredError, SignalProcessingError)
SQLite storage extending @plannr/storage-base with full migration system
SSE broadcaster as shared infrastructure (used by pipeline, jobs, trend detection — not trapped in API layer)
4 generic adapter types (poll_api, webhook, push, structured_pull) with SourceAdapter interface
All 30+ source presets across 5 tiers organized as factory functions
Source health escalation policy (1 fail → warn, 3 → unhealthy + SSE, 10 → disabled, auth error → immediate disable)
Auth encryption (AES-256-GCM) for source credentials
BullMQ job queue with Redis (6 queues: poll-sources, process-signal, ingest-document, recluster, decay, trend-detect)
Greenhouse gate (Tier 0): keyword require/exclude filtering
Rule Registry (Tier 1): Tuner-managed deterministic filter rules with effectiveness tracking
Local ML classification (Tier 2): Transformers.js zero-shot classifier, required at startup
LLM extraction (Tier 3): Sonnet structured extraction with JSON schema output
8-factor scoring with Tuner-managed weights per Greenhouse (recency, specificity, source_authority, repetition, emotional_intensity, strategic_fit, actionability, content_quality)
Grounded theory clustering via Haiku with auto-summary regeneration
Exact dedup (source_type + external_id) and near dedup (cluster + keyword overlap)
Document ingestion with chunking (recursive + speaker-aware for interviews) — pre-pipeline, in ingest-document worker
Signal decay engine (90-day half-life, daily scheduled job)
Trend detection (hourly, weekly/monthly velocity per cluster)
Weekly recluster (merge/split review via Sonnet)
Recommendation engine ('what should we build next?' via Sonnet, cached 15min)
Full REST API (Greenhouses, Signals, Clusters, Sources, Presets, Ingestion, Recommendations, Filter Rules, Dead Letter, Webhooks)
SSE event system (signal:new, signal:updated, cluster:new, cluster:updated, cluster:trending, ingestion:progress, ingestion:complete, source:error, source:auth_expired)
Dead letter queue (list, replay, replay-all, discard)
Tuner integration — dedicated feature: CultivateConfig polling (5 min), CultivateOutcome recording on link/dismiss, learning loop semantics
Default Greenhouse auto-creation on first start (refinement mode, all sources, no keyword filters)
Model name configurability via CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL and CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL env vars
Server mount as Express plugin at /api/cultivate
Fail-fast startup sequence: Redis → SQLite → Transformers.js → Anthropic API → Tuner config → Queues → Scheduled jobs

acceptance_criteria.description: cultivate refuses to start if Redis is unavailable, throwing CultivateStartupError('REDIS_UNAVAILABLE')
cultivate refuses to start if Transformers.js model fails to load, throwing CultivateStartupError('ML_MODEL_LOAD_FAILED')
cultivate refuses to start if Anthropic API health check fails, throwing CultivateStartupError('ANTHROPIC_UNAVAILABLE')
A manually created signal traverses the full pipeline: Tier 0 → Tier 1 → Tier 2 → Tier 3 → Score → Cluster → Store → SSE broadcast
Signals that fail Tier 1 rules are rejected with clear reason, never reaching the LLM
Signals that fail Tier 2 ML classification are rejected, never reaching Sonnet extraction
Dead-lettered signals (failed after BullMQ retries) are visible via GET /api/cultivate/dead-letter and replayable
No partial signals exist in storage — a signal completes the full pipeline or doesn't enter the system
Greenhouses independently filter, score, and cluster signals — same source can produce different scores in different Greenhouses. Clusters never span Greenhouses.
All 30+ source presets are registered and retrievable via GET /api/cultivate/presets
Source credentials are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM derived from CULTIVATE_SECRET
Decay job marks signals below 0.15 threshold as 'decayed', linked signals are exempt
Trend detection classifies clusters as rising/stable/declining and emits cluster:trending SSE on transition to rising
GET /api/cultivate/recommendations returns evidence-backed suggestions ranked by confidence, filterable by Greenhouse
Source health policy: 3 consecutive failures → unhealthy + SSE, 10 → disabled, auth errors → immediate disable
Package exports createCultivateService() following the same plugin pattern as planner, ideation, forge
When cultivate starts with no Greenhouses, a default Greenhouse is auto-created in refinement mode with all configured sources and no keyword filters
Tuner config is polled every 5 minutes from GET /api/tuner/config/cultivate. Link/dismiss actions post CultivateOutcome to POST /api/tuner/outcomes/cultivate.
A raw event from a source shared by 2 Greenhouses produces 2 independent process-signal jobs (one per matching Greenhouse)
CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL and CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL env vars configure which Anthropic models are used for extraction and clustering

observations: Follows exact same plugin pattern as planner/ideation/forge: createXxxService() → { router, initialize, shutdown }
Storage extends BaseSqliteStorage from @plannr/storage-base with synchronous initializeSchema()
Server mounts at app.use('/api/cultivate', cultivateService.router)
Uses @plannr/errors for consistent error handling (NotFoundError, BadRequestError, ValidationError, etc.)
Redis is NEW infrastructure — not used by any other package yet. BullMQ is a new dependency.
Transformers.js (@huggingface/transformers) is a new dependency — ~100MB model download on first run
The monorepo uses 'type: module' (ESM) throughout
better-sqlite3 is already a root dependency, Express 5.2.1, Zod 3.23.8
Anthropic SDK already available at root level
SSE broadcaster must be shared infrastructure — pipeline, jobs, and trend detection all emit events. Cannot live inside API layer or circular deps result.
Tuner integration follows the pattern of tuner-forge-integration and tuner-ideation-consumption: dedicated feature with client code, config polling, and outcome recording.
Chunking is PRE-pipeline (in ingest-document worker), not part of the process-signal pipeline. Each chunk becomes a separate signal.
Poll-sources worker handles per-Greenhouse fan-out: raw event → determine matching Greenhouses → enqueue one process-signal per match.
Clusters are scoped per-Greenhouse and never span Greenhouses — this is an architectural invariant.
Default Greenhouse auto-creation on first start ensures zero-config usability.
concerns: Redis adds operational complexity — first package requiring it
Transformers.js model download on first startup could be slow
BullMQ workers in same process — memory considerations with ML model loaded

observations: AES-256-GCM encryption for all source credentials (tokens, API keys, secrets)
CULTIVATE_SECRET env var required for encryption key derivation
HMAC webhook verification for incoming webhooks
No public-facing endpoints — all behind existing auth boundary
Source config validation via Zod prevents injection in endpoint templates

architect.llm_extract: Anthropic Sonnet for extraction (configurable via CULTIVATE_EXTRACT_MODEL)
architect.llm_cluster: Anthropic Haiku for clustering (configurable via CULTIVATE_CLUSTER_MODEL)
architect.llm_recommend: Anthropic Sonnet for recommendations and recluster
architect.sse: SSEBroadcaster as shared infrastructure — instantiated in startup, injected into pipeline/jobs/API
architect.tuner: Dedicated cultivate-tuner feature: config polling, outcome recording, learning loop
architect.no_fallbacks: Every dependency required at startup. No mock mode. No graceful degradation.
